lesson.menu_title: The Order That Came Out Wrong
lesson.menu_desc: A taverna in Athens, a plate you did not order, and what you say next -- first conditional -- 27 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 4 -- The Order That Came Out Wrong
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Sophia | Lesson 4 -- The Order That Came Out Wrong

listenings.text: Okay so the worst thing that happened to me on that trip was in a restaurant, and it was my own fault. I have an allergy, a bad one, to nuts. And I did not say anything because I was embarrassed about my English. The waiter recommended a dessert and I just said yes. And then it arrived and it was covered in pistachios. I did not eat it, obviously, but I felt so stupid, because the whole thing would have taken me one sentence. Now I say it first, before anything else. If the menu is not clear, I ask. If they do not have something without nuts, I order the fruit. It is not complicated. It was just scary the first time.

Good evening. Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes? Right. So the moussaka is our house dish, and I would recommend it, but I should tell you it is a very large portion, so perhaps share it between two. If you want something lighter, the grilled fish comes with salad. Now, about the pistachio dessert you asked for. I am afraid it is not available tonight, but if you like, I can bring you the yoghurt with honey instead. It is the same price. And I will bring you a receipt at the end, of course. Anything to drink while you decide?

reading.rtitle: Three reviews of the same taverna
paras: LEO, 14. We went twice. The first night the table was not ready, so we waited outside for ten minutes and they brought us olives while we waited, on the house. The moussaka is one enormous portion and my dad and I shared it. If you go with a big family, ask them to split the plates in the kitchen, because they will do it and it makes everything easier.

PRIYA, 13. I have a nut allergy and I was nervous about eating out in Greece. I said it at the door, before we sat down, and the waiter wrote it on his pad. When I asked about a dessert with pistachios he said it was not available for me and brought a substitute, the yoghurt with honey. If you have an allergy, say it first. They will not be annoyed, and if they cannot help they will tell you straight away.

TOM, 12. Our order came out wrong. I asked for the fish and they brought the chicken. I did not want to complain because my Greek is zero and my English is not great either, but my sister just said, sorry, I think this is the wrong plate, and it was fine in ten seconds. They took it back, they said sorry, and they gave us the bread for free. Ask for the receipt at the end and check it, because ours had the chicken on it.

gist.prompt: What do the three reviews have in common?
choices: The food was bad and all three of them complained.
Something went wrong, and in each case one sentence sorted it out.
None of them could speak any English at the taverna.

items: Leo and his father shared one portion of moussaka.
"The moussaka is one enormous portion and my dad and I shared it."
Priya told the waiter about her allergy after the food arrived.
She said it at the door, before they sat down.
Priya was offered a substitute for the pistachio dessert.
"brought a substitute, the yoghurt with honey"
Tom complained about the wrong plate himself.
His sister did it — he did not want to.

items.situation: The table is not ready yet. Say what you will do, with a first conditional.
tips: If the table isn't ready, we'll wait outside.
If it's a long wait, we'll come back later.

items.situation: You have an allergy. Say it before you order, politely.
tips: Could I ask about the ingredients? I have a nut allergy.
I have an allergy to nuts, so if a dish has them, I'll choose something else.

items.situation: They brought the wrong plate. Fix it in one sentence, without being rude.
tips: Sorry, I think this is the wrong plate. I ordered the fish.
Excuse me, could you check my order? I asked for the fish.

items.situation: You do not know the word for the dish. Describe it instead.
tips: It's a kind of bread that's flat and you put things on top.
It's the thing you use to pay without cash.

items.situation: The dessert you wanted is not available. Ask for a substitute and for the bill.
tips: If you don't have it, could I get the yoghurt instead?
Could I have the receipt when you have a moment?
